U-ID.note: Enumerate every persisted-key backend and migration file at 01/1; no backend wildcard is a write grant. Split new responsibilities into <=500-line modules; only surgical wiring in oversized existing files.

U-HOST.note: Serial ownership transfer 01 typed provenance -> 04 immutable grants/stdio. Kernels do not gain effect authority.

U-APPROVAL.note: full_harness.rs and handlers.rs are read-only provider contract unless a separately reviewed provider delta is required.

U-F6.note: Production file remains read-only until unchanged-baseline 02/5 reproduces crossover. No rmcp upgrade implied.

U-PROJECTION.note: Bind actual tool-result to event/history/model sink call sites at accepted checkpoint before writes; this is a proposed insertion surface, not an assertion that the full sink graph is enumerated.

U-TEST.owner: UAR integration implementer/verifier at completed boundary
U-TEST.note: Select real router fixtures with JWT enabled/private stores; migrate positive helpers without masking negatives.

B-APPROVAL.note: Resolve exact shared response/event types and consumers using Compass plus source fallback before materialization. No unrelated renderer redesign.

B-CLAIM.note: Preserve current claim-before-effect; no change unless scenario exposes a contract delta.

B-PROJECTION.note: integrationConfig.ts is a storage reference, not generic remote custody permission; selected host supplement controls any storage change.

B-BUILD.note: Read-only command/payload evidence; no packaging/config rewrite authorized.

F-HARNESS.owner: bossfang-feature-steward with explicit kernel scope extension
F-HARNESS.note: C05.1 selection; C05.2 lifecycle; C05.3 reconciliation and both identified A2A task lookup/cancel views for selected delegated jobs. Native task behavior preserved. Actual module exports/shared types require exact ownership supplement before writes; routes/network.rs transfers serially to F-MCP.
F-HARNESS.handoff: 03 sole writer completes delegated A2A view/cancel wiring and records checkpoint; only then F-MCP receives routes/network.rs for 04. No concurrent claims.

F-STORAGE.note: Backend decision must enumerate SQLite and configured Surreal task path; do not claim both supported until atomic projection transaction is implemented/verified. Migration number allocated at accepted checkpoint.

F-RETRY.note: Explicit retry -> handle -> substrate; stale sweep in accessors; cron AgentTurn -> send_message_full. Other reachable resumption/A2A paths must be resolved at 03/1, not assumed absent. Pending-task wake reconciliation reads pending tasks and dispatches trigger matches; do not bypass delegated uncertainty through this path.

F-MCP.owner: bossfang-feature-steward with explicit API scope extension
F-MCP.note: Bind identity structs and mode configuration at accepted checkpoint. Extend team default ownership explicitly; no blanket API write grant.
F-MCP.handoff: 04 MCP attribution only after F-HARNESS release; no changes to a2a_send_task/a2a_get_task/a2a_cancel_task unless explicitly re-planned.

F-TEST.owner: feature-steward authors; merge-reviewer independently reviews final delivery
F-TEST.note: Real kernel dispatch, UAR router/executor, product persistence and safe effect required; no test-only adapter substitute.

REMOTE.note: Unassigned by design: actual receiver and host/custodian required; no wildcard sibling permission. Supplement must fix repository root, base SHA, child change, exact files, resource contract and acceptance command.

materialization.when: After explicit Execute handover; before any product mutation
requirements: Revalidate source SHA and selected digests; preserve unrelated uncommitted files.
Create isolated product worktrees outside original checkouts, respecting repository convention.
Resolve C05 and shared-file ownership; claim exact files and obtain accepted dependency checkpoint.
Create repository-local OpenSpec child deltas under that worktree using the reviewed parent requirements; validate before kbd-apply.
Record child project UUID, worktree root, parent task key -> child task IDs, owner, baseline and acceptance references. Do not reuse original shipping KBD UUID or move original active phase.
Register children through typed runtime APIs only; parent coordinating tasks complete from linked child receipts, never solely from dispatch.
Re-review material child design changes; do not dispatch unresolved file sets or remote/durable supplements.
